name: agentwire
description: Connect coding agents across machines with dashboard-approved devices and pushed messages.

interface.longDescription: Approve a device from your dashboard and exchange directed or broadcast messages between agent chats. Uses the machine's existing Node 24.13–26 installation. Automatic incoming turns require the DOCa Codex fork's channel support.
defaultPrompt: Set up Agentwire on this device
Send an update to another agent
